name: PadShop
brief: A tiny shop: a floor with a SpawnLocation, 3 coins worth 10 each, and a shop pad. Standing on the shop pad buys a SpeedCoil tool for 25 coins if the player can afford it; otherwise nothing happens.
contract: leaderstats IntValue named Coins starting at 0; each Part named Coin (CanCollide false) adds 10 and is destroyed when touched.
The shop pad is a Part named BuyPad. Touching it with at least 25 Coins subtracts 25 and gives the player a Tool named SpeedCoil (put it in the player's Backpack). With fewer coins nothing happens.
A player must not be charged twice for one visit (debounce per player), and must not get a second SpeedCoil.
